paragraphs.text: Tucker is a molefolk on the plane of Bloomburrow .

Tucker is a molefolk , characterized by his patchwork, quilted jacket and spectacles perched on his nose. His appearance is modest, marked by his practical attire and the cane he uses for support. Despite his unassuming exterior, Tucker is attentive and skilled in hospitality, offering both assistance and refreshments to Helga and her companions. He is respectful and observant, providing valuable guidance about the surroundings and potential dangers.

Tucker first appeared as a caretaker and server, responding to the needs of Helga and her group after they were taken in by the ratfolk of the cavern. When Coffey , the elder of the ratfolk, offered them hospitality, Tucker was responsible for preparing and serving tea and seedcake. He attentively filled and carried mugs, and his service was marked by care and efficiency, demonstrating his role as a supportive member of the community. Later, Tucker provided essential information to Mabel and her companions about the route to Fountainport and the potential dangers they might face. He mentioned a recent storm and the presence of a dangerous creature . As they departed, Tucker guided them through a different set of tunnels, ensuring they were safely on their way.
